memory.learning: New typed user messages after completed turns; no history backfill or attachment/tool extraction

memory.extraction: Selected local model, constrained JSON, no tools/thinking, max 3 candidates, quote/value evidence validation
memory.usage: Learning input/output included in cumulative session totals with separate subset fields
memory.limits: 5000 catalog entries, 12 MiB; 60-second extraction deadline, max 768 output tokens

personalities.examples: Style reference only; excluded from extraction
